What IQVIA says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue, EBITDA and earningsThe company is raising its full-year 2026 guidance for revenue to be between $17,350 million and $17,500 million, for Adjusted EBITDA to be between $4,025 million and $4,055 million and for Adjusted Diluted Earnings per Share to be between $12.90 and $13.00.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
